description: Source code implementing ASN.1 related classes and methods for private IE IDs and fields in the NRPPa protocol, including serialization, deserialization, and JSON conversion.

classes.name: private_ie_id_c
classes.description: Represents a choice type for private IE ID, supporting local and global types, with methods for setting, serialization, and JSON conversion.

classes.name: private_ie_field_s
classes.description: Template class for ASN.1 sequence of private IE fields, with pack/unpack and JSON serialization.

classes.name: private_ie_container_item_s
classes.description: Template class for container items holding private IE ID, criticality, and value, with pack/unpack and JSON serialization.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the type of private_ie_id_c to a specified option.

methods.name: set_local
methods.description: Sets the private_ie_id_c to local type and returns reference to c.

methods.name: set_global
methods.description: Sets the private_ie_id_c to global type.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes private_ie_id_c or template classes to bit stream.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes private_ie_id_c or template classes from bit stream.
